full.text: Box 1 names at least one person and what fixing this would ask of them (a step, a habit, time, or a decision), drawn from column 3 of your What exists table.

3.text: A person named, the ask vague, or not tied to column 3.

1.text: No person, or a solution described instead of what it asks.

full.text: Box 2 holds all seven parts, dated, Part 3c now filled, and every row of Part 6 with its Status column filled and a reason for each rating.

3.text: A part or a few Status entries missing, or ratings without reasons.

1.text: Several parts missing, 3c blank, or Part 6 unchanged from Sprint 1.

full.text: Part 6 has at least one assumption rated high risk and unconfirmed.

3.text: A high-risk row marked confirmed without saying how.

full.text: Box 3 gives one of the three verdicts, and the reasons draw on the risk ratings, what exists, and what the change would ask.

3.text: A verdict with reasons from one of the three sources.

1.text: A verdict with no reasons, or reasons from feeling alone.

full.text: Box 3 says what is still uncertain and what would settle it. A "depends on" names what and who. A no names the runner-up.

3.text: Uncertainty named without what would settle it.

1.text: Nothing uncertain named, or a "depends on" with no condition.

grading_note: Read for meaning. Score each criterion once across the submission set. A blank part receives its criterion’s 1 rung. Cite the part and frame or table for every below-full judgment.
